summary: release-push.sh push-built checks the tar first, fetches main once, and when main's tip descends from the build's base and main's committed build is not newer (D2: base named by main's newest bot rebuild commit, else the newest dist-touching commit, is an ancestor of this base) commits dist/ and legion/ onto the tip with a temporary index (no checkout of the tip) and lands it through land_on_main; when a path in packages/claude-envoy/scripts/build-inputs.txt changed between base and tip (git diff --no-renames) it also starts one fresh run. A Bun test (packages/claude-envoy/tests/build-inputs.test.ts, added to pr-and-main.yaml's required test job) holds the list complete against the build's metafile inputs, staged skills, pi-legion agents and each reached package root's manifest, tsconfig and license files.
tasks: 1. packages/claude-envoy/scripts/build-inputs.txt (D1): one git pathspec per line, # comments; whole claude-envoy/envoy-client/contracts/pi-shared dirs minus dist/legion/tests/docs/changes; pi-legion/agents, skills, bun.lock, package.json, patches, .bun-version, bunfig.toml, .gitignore/.gitattributes (root and packages/), scripts/third-party-notices.ts, scripts/pi-plugin-prepack.sh, check-private-names.sh, release-push.sh, the workflow, setup-bun.
2. build.ts: buildBundles returns the metafile input paths.
3. packages/claude-envoy/tests/build-inputs.test.ts (D6), matching with git ls-files in a scratch repository; negative control: drop the packages/pi-shared line.

4. release-push.sh: deploy_key_env idempotent; land_on_main records its outcome and its notice/error stop calling <base-sha> the build's commit (push-fold's test updated too); push-built per D2/D3; header paragraphs rewritten (incl. the fetch-to-push race: land_on_main pushes only when main's tip is still HEAD's parent).

5. release-push.test.sh push-built cases a-l (docs-only move lands; input move lands + one fresh run; rename out of an input; excluded path inside input dir; list change; newer build on main lands nothing; equal build; rewritten main; main moves again between fetch and push; missing list; doctored tar refused with both kinds of move; gh failure after landing); rewrite the old 'moved' case.
6. Workflow header 20-31 and push-job comments; pr-and-main.yaml step running the Bun test.
7. Guides: packages/claude-envoy/AGENTS.md 165-179, README.md 274-279, docs/deployment.md 253-260, verify-build.sh header.
9. Bring main in only on a real conflict.

findings.finding: Outcome 'within one run' not met by land-only-when-unchanged (measured 30% of moved windows)
findings.answer: Sent to the architect; architect changed the spec (22:40Z) to land whenever newer and also start a fresh run when inputs changed. Plan follows it (D2, D3).
Acceptance 3 rewritten by the architect; plan's check compares C's built files with a build of the base its subject names (acceptance row 3), and push-built prints a 'Landing on main's tip' notice.

findings.finding: Inputs a metafile test misses: workspace LICENSE/NOTICE, .gitignore/.gitattributes, bunfig.toml, what bun install and setup-bun read
findings.answer: Whole package directories and explicit root paths in the list (D1); test probes LICENSE/NOTICE/tsconfig/package.json at each reached package root (D6).

findings.finding: Second deploy_key_env call leaves the key directory on disk
findings.answer: deploy_key_env returns early when already set up (D4); 'nothing left in TMPDIR' checks kept.

findings.finding: land_on_main messages false when passed the tip; both callers' tests pin the text
findings.answer: Reworded, both push-built and push-fold tests updated together (D4).

findings.finding: Race between push-built's fetch and the push
findings.answer: land_on_main pushes only when the tip is still HEAD's parent, never forced; a further move starts one fresh run; documented and tested (D5, case i).

findings.finding: Checking out the tip rewrites the running script
findings.answer: No checkout: temporary index, read-tree tip, commit-tree (D3.7).

findings.finding: Missing or empty list; existing fixtures lack it; 'moved' case flips
findings.answer: Missing/empty list counts as changed with a warning (case j); fixtures seed the real list; old 'moved' case rewritten.

findings.finding: No criterion for the list test or that it runs in a required job; AC1 lacks edge cases; AC2's jobs unnamed
findings.answer: Test added to pr-and-main.yaml's required test job with a negative control (D6); cases a-l; AC2 = pr-and-main.yaml lint/typecheck/test.
